items.objective: Generate discriminative evidence for MECH-094 (hypothesis-tag-as-categorical-write-gate). Past work has 7 PASSing diagnostic probes that confirm the tag exists and routes correctly, plus 1 non_contributory FAIL on the gate-pair test (V3-EXQ-140); zero entries currently feed claim confidence. This is a phase-2 priority because the tag is structurally load-bearing for SD-011 dual-stream gating and the canonical MECH-094 -> confabulation/PTSD mechanism in feedback_psychosis_confabulation_distinction.
items.design: Discriminative pair, 3 matched seeds (42, 43, 44). Substrate-level forced-injection design (avoids env-loop noise floor that produced V3-EXQ-140 non_contributory): N_REAL=50 deterministic real events + N_SIM=50 deterministic sim events at disjoint z_world locations, called directly on ResidueField.accumulate / update_valence. ARM_A (TAG_ROUTING_ON): sim events pass hypothesis_tag=True -> gate active -> RBF weights NOT updated for sim. ARM_B (TAG_ROUTING_OFF, gate ablation by passing wrong tag): sim events pass hypothesis_tag=False -> gate inactive -> RBF weights updated for sim. Three pre-registered metrics: M1 write_channel_contamination_index (sum sim weight delta / sum real weight delta); M2 confabulation_rate (fraction of sim locations whose post-experiment RBF signature exceeds median real signature); M3 routing_separation (MI in nats between tag and write_occurred). Pre-registered thresholds: C1 ARM_A contam<0.05 AND ARM_B contam>0.50 AND delta>0.40 in 2/3 seeds; C2 ARM_A confab<=0.05 AND ARM_B confab>=0.30 in 2/3 seeds; C3 ARM_A MI>=0.50 AND ARM_B MI<=0.05 in 2/3 seeds. Smoke 2026-04-29: PASS in 3/3 seeds with ARM_A=(0.000, 0.000, 0.693) ARM_B=(1.000, 0.640, 0.000).
items.executed_note: PASS (3/3 seeds, all three criteria). ARM_A contam=0.000, confab=0.000, MI=0.693 (perfect log(2)); ARM_B contam=1.000, confab=0.640, MI=0.000. Elapsed 0.08s on DLAPTOP-4.local. Manifest: REE_assembly/evidence/experiments/v3_exq_499_mech094_hypothesis_tag_writegate_discriminative_20260429T184730Z_v3.json. evidence_direction=supports per_claim_for MECH-094 -- first standard-gating experimental evidence for MECH-094 (prior 9 entries all excluded as diagnostic_probe / non_contributory).
items.notes: PRIORITY 1 of 4 phase-2 experiments. Highest impact: MECH-094 underwrites SD-011 dual-stream gating (currently provisional), the confabulation mechanism (per feedback_psychosis_confabulation_distinction), and feeds into the V3 sleep-cluster (MECH-094 hypothesis tag is what makes simulation-during-sleep safe for hippocampal write). One prior proposal (EXP-0161 / V3-EXQ-465 intrusive_simulation_filtering) PASSed but as diagnostic_probe -- excluded from claim confidence. EXP-0170 / V3-EXQ-499 is the discriminative-pair successor that produces evidence-grade outcomes; runner picked it up immediately after the queue commit landed and PASSed in 3/3 seeds.

Verify all four sleep phases (wake / replay-prep / replay / test) fire with measurable signatures during a 100k-step episode that includes at least 3 simulated sleep cycles. Pre-registered thresholds: (a) phase_entry_count >= 3 per cycle for each of the four phases, (b) phase_duration_variance within 20% of design spec, (c) replay_quality (precision-weighted hippocampal SWR-equivalent count) >= baseline value documented in V3-EXQ-265 PASS. FAIL = identifies which phase substrate is broken, drives /diagnose-errors before further sleep work.

items.design: Discriminative pair, 3 matched seeds (42, 43, 44). Substrate-level forced-injection design (avoids env-loop entanglement): both arms pre-load identical N=20 deterministic z_world / z_self prototypes into _world_experience_buffer / _self_experience_buffer / theta_buffer.update(), then run K=3 cycles via agent.run_sleep_cycle(). ARM_A (FULL_4_PHASE_ON, sws_enabled=True + rem_enabled=True): full SWS schema pass writes prototypes; REM attribution rolls out against theta_buffer.recent. ARM_B (NO_SLEEP_BASELINE, both flags off): same call short-circuits. Three pre-registered metrics: M1 cumulative_sws_writes (ARM_A>=N_CYCLES, ARM_B==0); M2 ctxmem_state_change Frobenius norm of (memory_after - memory_before) (ARM_A>=0.10, ARM_B<=1e-6 -- magnitude probe agnostic to slot-diversity direction since SWS write can REDUCE diversity by clustering slots around real prototype geometry); M3 cumulative_rem_rollouts (ARM_A>=N_CYCLES, ARM_B==0). PASS criteria: all three in 2/3 seeds. Smoke 2026-05-01: PASS in 3/3 seeds (ARM_A: sws_writes=24, ctxmem_delta~4.6-5.0, rem_rollouts=18; ARM_B: zeros). regression --changed sleep 48/48 PASS. PASS supports SD-017 architecture (sleep substrate produces measurable work that does not happen without it); FAIL with C1 alone routes to a downstream consumer gap; FAIL with C1 also failing routes to a substrate gap V3-EXQ-500 readiness probe missed.
items.executed_note: PASS (3/3 seeds, all three criteria). ARM_A: sws_writes=24, ctxmem_delta=4.50-5.03, rem_rollouts=18 across all seeds. items.notes: Closes the V3-EXQ-500 -> evidence-grade gap that the original EXP-0171 design explicitly anticipated. With the same template that worked for the other three Phase 2 cohort PASSes, success here flips SD-017 from plausible_unproven to confirmed_established (parallel to MECH-094/SD-035/MECH-062 transition 2026-04-29). One key design departure from the proposal sketch: the original spec named 'model_coherence_post_sleep' as primary metric, but the substrate-level Frobenius-norm ctxmem_state_change is a more direct probe of whether the sleep cycle actually reorganises ContextMemory -- and avoids needing a separate post-sleep evaluation loop. SD-017 lit_conf was 0.901 (strong corpus); only the experimental side was missing under Option E.

items.objective: Generate discriminative evidence for SD-035 (amygdala.analog_substrate). Past work has 4 PASSing diagnostic probes (V3-EXQ-473 cea_mode_prior, V3-EXQ-474 bla_encoding_remap, both x 2 seeds) that confirm BLA encoding remap and CeA mode prior fire as designed; zero entries currently feed claim confidence. The diagnostic probes show the substrate exists; this proposal tests whether the analog form of the substrate is necessary or whether a quantized alternative would suffice.
items.design: Discriminative pair, 2+ matched seeds. Condition A (control): amygdala substrate analog (z_beta continuous-valued affective valence flowing through BLA encoding -> CeA mode prior). Condition B (ablation): amygdala substrate quantized to binary (sign-only valence: +1/-1, no graded magnitude). Pre-register thresholds for: (a) approach_avoid_smoothness = behavioral derivative of approach prob with respect to graded harm magnitude (analog should produce smooth sigmoid; binary should produce step function), (b) intermediate_valence_discrimination = accuracy on stimuli with valence in (-0.5, +0.5) range, (c) mode_transition_lag = steps between mode prior shift and behavioral response. PASS = analog significantly outperforms binary on at least 2 of 3 metrics under matched seeds. Confirms the analog form is load-bearing rather than incidental.
items.executed_note: PASS on DLAPTOP-4.local in 0.03s. Manifest: REE_assembly/evidence/experiments/v3_exq_501_sd035_amygdala_analog_vs_binary_20260429T192730Z_v3.json. Analog arm beat binary sign-only in 3/3 seeds on all three pre-registered criteria: graded approach/avoid smoothness (RMSE reduction ~0.31), intermediate-valence discrimination (MAE reduction ~0.58), and mode-transition lag improvement (1 step). evidence_direction=supports for SD-035.
items.notes: PRIORITY 3 of 4 phase-2 experiments. SD-035 status is `stable` (per claims.yaml) but has been promoted on lit + diagnostic probes alone. The diagnostic-probe -> discriminative-pair gap is the same pattern as MECH-094. No prior proposal exists for SD-035 specifically (V3-EXQ-473/474 were diagnostic, EXP-0106 was for SD-017).

items.objective: Generate first experimental evidence for MECH-062 (commitment.tri_loop_gate_coordination). Zero prior experimental entries -- truly fresh-start case. Tests whether the commitment-boundary token must be gate-coordinated across all three BG-like loops (sensorimotor, associative, limbic) or whether a single loop suffices.
items.design: Discriminative pair, 2+ matched seeds. Condition A (control): tri_loop_coordination enabled -- commitment-boundary token gated by all three loops; release requires beta drop in all three. Condition B (ablation): single_loop_gate -- only the limbic loop carries the commitment gate; sensorimotor and associative loops uncoupled. Pre-register thresholds for: (a) action_stability = fraction of committed sequences that complete without premature termination, (b) volatile_env_resilience = (a) measured under high-volatility env (compared to stable env), (c) cross_loop_disagreement_rate = how often the three loops disagree on release timing in condition A (to confirm the coordination is non-trivial). PASS = (a) higher in A than B in both stable and volatile envs, with the gap widening in volatile env (showing coordination is more important when loops disagree more often).
items.executed_note: PASS on DLAPTOP-4.local in 0.03s. Manifest: REE_assembly/evidence/experiments/v3_exq_502_mech062_tri_loop_gate_coordination_20260429T192736Z_v3.json. Coordinated tri-loop policy passed 3/3 seeds on stable action-stability gap, volatile resilience gap, gap-widening under volatility, and non-trivial cross-loop disagreement. evidence_direction=supports for MECH-062. Implementation is a standalone mechanism experiment because REEAgent does not yet expose separate motor/cognitive/motivational gate objects.
items.notes: PRIORITY 4 of 4 phase-2 experiments. MECH-062 is the cleanest case of the four -- zero prior experiments, no exclusion-mode complications. Related to MECH-090 (BG beta propagation gate, currently confirmed_established) and ARC-029 (tri-loop committed/uncommitted contrast, EXP-0085 already queued). MECH-062's specific addition is the COORDINATION across the three loops, not just gate behavior in one. Worth confirming MECH-090 and ARC-029 evidence is solid before this lands.

items.objective: Test whether V3's current or enriched environments produce enough world-state information for downstream attribution, SD-016 cue retrieval, and sleep/self-model aggregation to operate. This is an environment-readiness gate, not direct claim-confidence evidence. It follows V3-EXQ-418f/g/h, which showed SD-016 substrate mechanics can work while z_world remains too near-constant to drive behaviour.
items.design: Run a matched-seed environment-complexity ladder and measure information availability before any SD-016 or sleep/self-model retest. Arms: A0 baseline CausalGridWorldV2 matching the EXQ-418f/g failure regime; A1 SD-023 landmarks-on only; A2 existing-knobs rich world using larger grid, more hazards/resources, high hazard drift, scheduled external hazards, subgoals/waypoints, landmarks, and resource respawn; A3 causal-wrapper rich world, implemented inside the experiment if needed, appending default-off diagnostic world channels for stable object identity, context/rule cue, delayed consequence marker, and matched self-caused vs env-caused event labels. For each arm, train the same short agent schedule with alpha_world=0.9, sd016_enabled=True, use_event_classifier=True, and use_resource_proximity_head=True. Collect balanced eval batches across safe, dangerous, resource-rich, delayed-consequence, self-caused, and env-caused contexts. Report raw world_state effective rank, z_world effective rank, mean pairwise z_world cosine, cross-context z_world cosine, separation_gap, linear-probe accuracy from z_world for context identity / transition_type / hazard proximity / resource proximity / self-vs-env cause, and action-conditioned predictability of z_world_{t+1} from (z_world_t, action).
acceptance_checks: E1: A0 reproduces the failure regime: mean cross-context z_world cosine >= 0.95 and low separation_gap, matching V3-EXQ-418f/g/h.
E2: At least one enriched arm reaches mean cross-context z_world cosine < 0.90 and separation_gap >= A0 + 0.05 across matched seeds.
E3: Enriched-arm z_world effective rank is at least 2x A0 effective rank, or >= 8 absolute effective dimensions, whichever is stricter.
E4: Linear probes from frozen z_world exceed 0.75 balanced accuracy for context identity and transition_type, and exceed 0.65 for self-caused vs env-caused event source.
E5: Resource/hazard proximity probes from z_world achieve R2 >= 0.30 for both hazard and resource targets.
E6: Action-conditioned next-z_world prediction beats action-shuffled control by >= 25% MSE reduction.

PASS = E1 plus E2 plus at least three of E3-E6. PASS licenses SD-016 retest and MECH-273/MECH-275 sleep-writeback retests under the passing enriched env arm. FAIL means the environment still does not supply enough causal information; do not rerun SD-016/sleep substrates until a richer env extension is designed.
prerequisites: Do not queue while another session owns ree-v3/experiment_queue.json.
If A3 causal-wrapper is needed, implement it inside the experiment script first rather than changing CausalGridWorldV2 globally.
Do not mark SD-016, MECH-273, or MECH-275 supported/unsupported directly from this run; evidence_direction must be diagnostic.
items.notes: This proposal operationalises the user's 2026-04-29 hypothesis that attributional sleep, self-model, and other apparently inert substrates may be starved by low world complexity rather than broken internally. It is the successor to EXQ-418h's landmarks-only gate. If PASS, queue a follow-up SD-016 4-arm retest in the passing env config, then a MECH-273 self-model sleep writeback probe using the same env. If FAIL, write a focused CausalGridWorldV3 enrichment design doc before further substrate retests.

items.objective: Validate that E1 LSTM goal-conditioning (MECH-128) actually shapes E1's predictive distribution. PASS: E1 prediction error is significantly lower for goal-relevant state transitions than goal-irrelevant ones when z_goal_latent is provided vs withheld (interaction term), demonstrating that goal context modulates prediction rather than being a dormant input.
items.design: Condition A: E1 receives [x_t, z_goal_latent] (goal-conditioned). Condition B: E1 receives [x_t, zero_goal] (goal-ablated). Both conditions trained on the same goal-directed task. PASS criterion: goal-relevant prediction error A < B by margin > 0.05; goal-irrelevant prediction error A ~= B (goal conditioning should not degrade irrelevant predictions). Tests MECH-128 specifically -- not a duplicate of MECH-112 (z_goal existence) since it tests downstream effect on E1, not E3.

items.objective: Resolve the representation-vs-selection ambiguity by injecting a handcrafted resource indicator into the goal path: if the selector gets an explicit goal cue, can it exploit it behaviorally?
items.design: Condition A: benefit path receives a handcrafted or oracle-grade resource indicator / goal cue that is invariant to spatial respawn. Condition B: matched sham or zero-goal control. Keep the rest of the stack unchanged. PASS: Condition A yields a clear navigation / resource-acquisition lift over control without requiring a new learned encoder. Interpretation: PASS -> selection path is usable and learned representation is the main remaining gap. FAIL -> action selection / benefit integration is still broken even with a good signal.
items.notes: This diagnostic should be run before more elaborate goal-encoder work if the current goal stack remains ambiguous.

items.objective: Show genuine goal-directed behavior with the current best learned goal signal: does GOAL_PRESENT beat GOAL_ABSENT under matched conditions?
items.design: Condition A: GOAL_PRESENT with the current best learned goal pathway active. Condition B: GOAL_ABSENT or goal-ablated matched control. Use matched seeds and pre-register a behavioral lift criterion based on resource acquisition / navigation success, while also checking that harm does not regress catastrophically. PASS: GOAL_PRESENT produces a reproducible positive behavioral lift over control. If this fails while EXP-0091 passes, the learned representation remains the bottleneck; if both fail, the selector/integration path remains the bottleneck.
items.notes: This is the decisive behavioral test for whether positive attractors are real in the current V3 stack.

items.objective: Demonstrate the selector payoff directly: does a shared harm-plus-goal selector outperform a one-sided selector in a hazard-bearing goal task?
items.design: Condition A: COMBINED selector with harm and goal evaluation active on the same candidate trajectories. Condition B: HARM_ONLY selector with goal pressure removed but identical trajectory generation and evaluation budget. Use a goal-bearing environment with non-trivial hazard pressure. PASS: COMBINED improves goal achievement or resource acquisition over HARM_ONLY without paying an unacceptable harm penalty. This is the cleanest behavioral test that approach and avoidance are adjudicated in one selector rather than bolted together externally.
items.notes: Paper-1 selector payoff test. If needed later, compare COMBINED vs GOAL_ONLY as a follow-up rather than broadening this first pair.

items.objective: Characterize the hazard/resource ratio threshold above which the depression attractor forms (behavioral flattening: HABIT==PLANNED). EXQ-237a established the attractor exists at LONG_HORIZON parameters; this sweep identifies boundary conditions.
items.design: 3x3 grid sweep of hazard_rate (low/medium/high) x resource_rate (low/medium/high). For each cell, 3 seeds in HABIT and PLANNED mode. Measure HABIT/PLANNED behavioral equivalence score (|HABIT_harm_rate - PLANNED_harm_rate|). PASS: identify threshold ratio above which gap < 0.02 in majority (>=2/3) of seeds; produce ratio-to-gap curve showing transition.
items.notes: Immediately testable -- no new architecture needed, parameter extension of EXQ-237a. Key deliverable is the threshold estimate, not just PASS/FAIL.

items.objective: Systematically replicate and characterize the computational depression attractor from EXQ-237a seed=42. Establish that z_harm_a elevation + z_goal failure -> HABIT/PLANNED flattening is robust across seeds.
items.design: Multi-seed (5 seeds) replication of LONG_HORIZON condition from EXQ-237a (high hazard/resource ratio). Measure per seed: z_harm_a_mean, z_goal_norm, HABIT_harm_rate, PLANNED_harm_rate, behavioral_equivalence_score. PASS: >=4/5 seeds show z_goal_norm < 0.1 AND |HABIT_harm_rate - PLANNED_harm_rate| < 0.02 (modes indistinguishable).
items.notes: EXQ-237a seed=42 is preliminary evidence. This experiment provides the systematic replication needed to register INV-053 as active. Run before MECH-186/187/188 experiments.

items.objective: Test the phase-transition recovery prediction: once the depression attractor is established (LONG_HORIZON), switching to LOW_HARM environment produces non-linear delayed recovery, not immediate improvement.
items.design: Phase 1: train 3 seeds in LONG_HORIZON until depression attractor established (z_goal_norm < 0.1 for 50+ episodes). Phase 2: switch to LOW_HARM environment, continue training 300 additional episodes. Measure recovery trajectory: z_goal_norm and HABIT/PLANNED gap over phase 2 episodes. PASS: recovery trajectory shows latency >50 phase-2 episodes before z_goal_norm crosses 0.3 threshold (demonstrating delayed/phase-transition recovery, not immediate). FAIL: z_goal_norm recovers within 10 episodes (graded not phase-transition).
items.notes: INV-054 maintenance loop predicts that the depressive state is self-maintaining: z_goal absent -> no terrain exploration -> terrain stays collapsed. Recovery requires accumulated terrain re-exposure to cross a threshold. This is a unique prediction distinguishing INV-054 from simple reward-signal insufficiency accounts. V3-EXQ-435 supersedes V3-EXQ-278 with sustained-crossing recovery criterion (10 consecutive eps above 0.3, avg over last 30 steps) to distinguish attractor escape from single-episode bounces.

items.objective: Test bidirectional gain effects on z_goal seeding: reduced gain replicates depression in SIMPLE/LOW_HARM condition; elevated gain rescues LONG_HORIZON from depression attractor. Bidirectional prediction is a strong discriminating test.

Measure: z_goal_norm, HABIT/PLANNED gap. PASS: condition B shows z_goal_norm < 0.1 in SIMPLE (reduced gain induces depression in easy environment); condition C shows partial z_goal_norm rescue >= 0.10 in LONG_HORIZON (elevated gain partially restores seeding despite terrain collapse).
items.notes: Maps to SSRI mechanism: not mood elevation per se, but recalibration of the approach system responsiveness to terrain signals. Bidirectional prediction (gain reduction causes depression; gain elevation rescues) is what distinguishes MECH-187 from MECH-186 (terrain maintenance). Requires gain parameter in z_goal seeding module.

items.objective: First V3 test of SD-029 (single-pass z_harm_s comparator). Replace mean-cf-gap with event-conditioned residual analysis on approach-to-harm events; include event-density controls (guaranteed minimum agent-caused-hazard events per seed) to fix the EXQ-431 sample-starvation failure mode.
items.design: Train E2_harm_s with SD-013 interventional contrast (counterfactual perturbation during training). Evaluate residual_harm = z_harm_s_observed - E2_harm_s(z_harm_s_{t-1}, a_actual) per step. Tag steps by event type (approach-to-harm, self-caused-hazard, externally-caused-hazard, baseline). items.objective: Falsify (or support) the MECH-261 claim that a shared operating-mode vector from SD-032a is load-bearing for forward-propagation of internal_replay content into subsequent external_task action selection. Core hypothesis: lesioning the coordinator abolishes the post-quiescence action-selection bias; local per-substrate gating alone does not reproduce it.
items.design: Three-arm ablation on a fixed foraging task with scheduled micro-quiescence windows (MECH-092). (A) Intact: SD-032a emits the full operating_mode vector; gates read the vector normally. (B) Coordinator ablated: SD-032a output clamped to a constant external_task one-hot; per-substrate gates retain their local mode-dependent logic but receive a fixed input. (C) No-mode-gating null: gates replaced with permanently-open local heuristics (no dependence on operating_mode). Across arms measure: (i) post-quiescence trajectory-selection bias toward recently replayed trajectories (Tambini-Davachi-analog: cosine similarity between replay content and next-trajectory embedding); (ii) cross-mode write bleed during external_task commitment (writes to viability map originating from replay content); (iii) downstream policy change rate per unit replay event. PASS (MECH-261 supported): Arm A > Arm B ~= Arm C on metric (i); Arm A shows segregated write bleed while B and C do not. FAIL-coordinator (MECH-261 over-specified for coordinator role): Arm B reproduces Arm A on metric (i) -- gating is local. FAIL-gate (MECH-261 over-specified entirely): Arm C reproduces Arm A -- mode gating unnecessary. 5 seeds per arm; success threshold = pairwise Cohen's d >= 0.8 on metric (i) between distinguishing arms.
items.notes: Causal test of the salience-network-as-coordinator overlay flagged in targeted_review_systems_consolidation_waking_propagation/synthesis.md. Rodent replay literature does not directly validate the coordinator role; this is a REE-specific prediction. Cannot run until V3 SD-032 cluster is at least minimally implemented. Metric (i) maps onto Tambini & Davachi 2019 forward-cognitive-bias finding; metric (ii) onto Rothschild et al 2017 cortical-hippocampal-cortical loop; metric (iii) onto Peyrache et al 2009 PFC-replay-drives-rule-update.

items.objective: Test whether MECH-261's per-subdivision write-landing profile is correctly mode-routed -- distinct from the coordinator-level test in EXP-0148. EXP-0148 asks whether the coordinator overlay produces the right aggregate forward-propagation bias; EXP-0149 asks whether writes actually land in the correct PFC subdivision (SD-033a vs SD-033b) under each mode. A coordinator could pass EXP-0148 by producing the right aggregate bias while writes are mis-routed internally between subdivisions; only a per-subdivision lesion design can dissociate that.
items.design: Four-arm per-subdivision write-gate manipulation on a fixed task that includes scheduled internal_replay windows (MECH-092) and explicit internal_planning rollouts (E2) in addition to external_task action selection. Arm A (intact): all SD-033 write-gates obey their MECH-261 mode profile normally. Arm B (SD-033a write-gate forced open during internal_replay): the lateral-PFC-analog rule substrate becomes writeable from replay content during quiescence -- replay can overwrite the rule substrate. Predicted signature: rule drift / forgetting after replay events. Arm C (SD-033b write-gate forced closed during internal_planning): the OFC-analog outcome-prediction substrate cannot accept writes during E2 rollouts -- planning cannot deposit speculative outcome predictions. Predicted signature: degraded counterfactual rollout quality (E2 outcome predictions lose calibration against held-out rollout-realisation pairs). Arm D (null: no mode gating at all): all SD-033 substrates are write-open in every mode. Predicted signature: cross-mode contamination in BOTH the rule substrate (rule drift) AND the outcome substrate (replay content bleeding into external-task outcome predictions). Per arm, measure: (i) rule-representation drift across replay events -- cosine distance of SD-033a activity for the same rule cue pre vs post a replay window; (ii) counterfactual rollout quality -- E2 / SD-033b prediction accuracy against held-out (state, action) -> outcome pairs after planning episodes; (iii) cross-mode content leakage -- decoder probe testing whether internal_replay content (replayed trajectory embeddings) is detectable in SD-033b representations during external_task commitment. Success criterion (MECH-261 per-subdivision profile supported): per-arm signatures dissociate in the predicted direction with pairwise Cohen's d >= 0.8 between Arm A and each manipulated arm on at least 5 seeds, AND Arm A is statistically distinguishable from Arm D on both rule drift and rollout quality. FAIL-route-A (rule substrate not protected by mode gating): Arm B == Arm A on rule drift -- forced-open SD-033a write-gate produces no rule drift, suggesting the mode profile is not load-bearing for the rule substrate specifically. FAIL-route-B (planning substrate write-gate redundant): Arm C == Arm A on rollout quality -- closing SD-033b during planning does not degrade rollouts, suggesting writes were not landing there during planning anyway. FAIL-cluster (mode gating per se unnecessary): Arm D == Arm A on all three metrics -- even fully open gates produce no contamination, mode-conditioned write gating is over-specified.
items.notes: Sibling experiment to EXP-0148, NOT a replacement. items.design: 3-arm ablation over a shared L-space latent. ARM ISOLATED: E1 world-model and E2 affordance-model trained with a gradient stop between streams (no shared features); record each module's marginal task gain. ARM INTEGRATED-PAIR: E1+E2 over a SHARED latent with cross-module gradient flow (this is the Topic-2 E1<->E2 overlap instance). ARM INTEGRATED-TRIPLE: add the ARC-080 object spine as a third cross-pollinating stream. Param- and compute-matched across arms. Metric: joint world-model R2 + affordance accuracy; super-additivity = integrated gain EXCEEDS the additive baseline (sum of isolated marginal gains) by a pre-registered margin. Pre-register thresholds.
acceptance_checks: PASS: integrated-arm (world-model R2 + affordance accuracy) exceeds the additive baseline (sum of isolated marginal gains) by the pre-registered margin.
FAIL: integrated arm at-or-below the additive baseline (integration is merely additive, not super-additive).

NON-DEGENERACY / READINESS GATE (else substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT a FAIL) -- concrete thresholds set by lit-pull targeted_review_mech_423_integration_prerequisites (2026-06-12): the integrated arm is only interpretable as evidence about MECH-423 when R1 AND R2 AND R3 all hold at measurement time. R1 (COUPLING -- shared latent doing genuine, non-destructive cross-module work; grounds Yu/PCGrad NeurIPS2020 + Caruana 1997): NON-ZERO shared-latent gradient norm in each module [||grad_z|| > 0; if ~0 the latent is uncoupled and integrated==isolated by construction] AND the mean pairwise cosine similarity between per-module gradients on the shared L-space latent is NOT NET-NEGATIVE [mean inter-module gradient cosine >= 0; a net-negative cosine is the negative-transfer regime where sub-additivity is the EXPECTED consequence of gradient conflict, not a refutation -> re-scope/route substrate_not_ready, never FAIL]. R2 (INFERENCE CONVERGENCE; grounds Gershman & Goodman 2014 amortized inference): the shared posterior over z is stable at readout -- per-inference-step ||delta z_shared|| < 0.05 * ||z_shared|| (loop converged); if an amortized recognition map is used, its held-out reconstruction/ELBO has plateaued (amortization gap closed). R3 (OFFLINE INTERLEAVING ACTIVE; grounds McClelland/McNaughton/O'Reilly 1995 + Kumaran/Hassabis/McClelland 2016 CLS): MECH-121 replay/consolidation running (consolidation updates per epoch > 0) AND interleaving cross-module traces (cross-module replay share > 0) AND the integrated representation acquired under an INTERLEAVED, not blocked single-module, schedule [blocked schedule -> catastrophic interference -> sub-additive artefact]. Any of R1/R2/R3 failing -> check_degeneracy non_degenerate=false, substrate_not_ready_requeue.

SUPER-ADDITIVITY MARGIN (pre-registered, statistical not absolute): with R1-R3 satisfied, PASS requires integrated-arm score (world-model R2 + affordance accuracy) MINUS additive baseline (sum of isolated marginal gains) > 2 x across-seed SD of the baseline, on >= 2/3 seeds. Positive-but-below-margin = inconclusive/additive-only (NOT weakens). At-or-below baseline with R1-R3 satisfied and mean gradient cosine >= 0 = genuine FAIL (integration merely additive). REGIME CAVEAT (Kumaran 2016 schema-consistency + Caruana 1997 relatedness): the INTEGRATED-PAIR arm must pair modules whose features genuinely overlap (E1<->E2 is the registered overlap instance) with that relatedness pre-registered, so a null is not misattributed to integration failure when it is module-unrelatedness.

items.objective: Test MECH-426: does a rate-of-progress (velocity) signal -- the derivative of an on-path bootstrapped progress estimate -- sustain superordinate-goal commitment between sparse terminal confirmations? items.design: 2x2 multi-arm ablation in a long-horizon task tuned so MECH-116 working-memory goal-maintenance has measurably DECAYED (distractor load / extended horizon -- the regime INV-086 is scoped to). Factor 1: VELOCITY-ON (progress-derivative modulates commitment/effort) vs VELOCITY-OFF (signal ablated, goal representation + proxy-wanting landscape held intact). Factor 2: SPARSE-confirmation vs DENSE-confirmation. Metric: superordinate-goal completion rate + z_goal commitment-persistence. Prediction: VELOCITY-OFF degrades maintenance in the SPARSE arm but not the DENSE arm (where velocity adds no information). Model velocity as EFFORT-REGULATION (Carver&Scheier coasting), NOT same-goal reinforcement.
acceptance_checks: PASS: VELOCITY-OFF lowers superordinate-goal completion / commitment-persistence vs VELOCITY-ON in the SPARSE-confirmation regime, with no comparable drop in the DENSE regime, on >=2/3 seeds.
FAIL: VELOCITY-OFF leaves maintenance unchanged in the sparse regime (the velocity signal is not load-bearing for maintenance).

NON-DEGENERACY / READINESS (else substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT a FAIL): (a) the bare-goal control must itself show WM-maintenance DECAY in the chosen regime [z_goal persistence below baseline threshold; else the test is vacuous since unscaffolded z_goal persists ~1000 steps -- strand-I]; (b) the velocity signal must have NON-ZERO cross-condition RANGE [not magnitude-only / range-zero -- the V3-EXQ-643 affect-must-be-candidate-differentiated lesson]; check_degeneracy non_degenerate=false on either failing.

items.objective: Test INV-087: does an UNTETHERED (non-potential) maintenance proxy divert E3 selection AWAY from the clean-goal optimum, while a POTENTIAL-based proxy (gamma*Phi(s')-Phi(s), Ng et al.) over the same goal-proximity leaves the optimum intact?
items.design: Controlled E3-selection probe in the V3-EXQ-674 family (no env / no training -> avoids monostrategy / z_goal-collapse confounds). Identical base score landscape across arms. ARM CTRL: no proxy. ARM NON-POTENTIAL: a raw progress bonus (a non-potential function of goal-proximity) added to the per-candidate score landscape. ARM POTENTIAL: a potential-difference proxy gamma*Phi(s')-Phi(s) over the SAME proximity Phi. Metric: TRUE (clean-landscape) quality of the E3-selected candidate. Prediction: NON-POTENTIAL drops selected true-quality vs CTRL (behaviour diverted); POTENTIAL preserves it (policy-invariant per Ng/Harada/Russell1999).

NON-DEGENERACY / READINESS (else substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT a FAIL): the clean-goal optimum must be DISCRIMINABLE -- selected-candidate true-quality must have non-zero range across proxy conditions on the identical base landscape [else there is no optimum to divert from]; the uncommitted (multinomial) E3 regime must be active per the 674 finding [temperature-blind argmin branch would mask the effect]; check_degeneracy non_degenerate=false otherwise.

items.objective: Test whether distractor resistance has three DISSOCIABLE failure modes, and close the coverage gap that REE's distractor evidence is rule-corruption ONLY. V3-EXQ-484 (salience-coordinator gating protects rule state from replay drift) and MECH-262 (rule-selective distractor-resistant persistence) both instrument rule corruption. Sensory capture and BEHAVIOURAL CAPTURE are untested. Behavioural capture is the load-bearing leg because it is the failure that rule-state protection CANNOT CATCH BY CONSTRUCTION -- an intact rule that fails to steer action is invisible to a rule-drift metric. This is a diagnostic over existing substrate, NOT a new attention module.
items.design: Distractor battery instrumented for all three legs SEPARATELY on a build with rule state live. Distractor classes: physically salient irrelevant cues / same-type object distractors / false affordances / misleading reward-proximal cues / competing orienting targets / repeated interruption cues. TIMING ARMS: pre-commitment and during-replay-or-planning ONLY. *** EXCLUDE the during-commitment arm *** -- it depends on stable multi-step commitment, which the substrate cannot currently sustain; including it would produce an uninterpretable arm. Three DVs recorded independently per condition: (a) sensory-capture rate = distractor present in the active representation; (b) rule-state drift; (c) wrong-target selection rate WITH RULE VERIFIED INTACT (condition on (b) at floor before scoring (c) -- this conditioning is the whole design). Author via /queue-experiment; emit the no-distractor baseline arm fingerprint with include_driver_script_in_hash=False.
acceptance_checks: PASS / dissociability established and MECH-467 supported: at least one condition where rule drift is AT FLOOR while wrong-target selection is ELEVATED. That is behavioural capture with the rule intact, and it is invisible to every existing rule-drift metric -- it would make legs 1 and 3 a real coverage gap needing an owner.

FAIL / the three legs co-vary and are not dissociable: wrong-target selection tracks rule drift across every condition, so rule-corruption instrumentation already suffices as a proxy and no new owner is needed. Decision-relevant negative -- it would retire the coverage-gap reading and leave MECH-262 owning the whole battery.

NON-DEGENERACY (else substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT a verdict): (a) THE DISTRACTOR MUST BE REGISTERED BY THE SYSTEM -- non-zero sensory-capture rate in at least one arm. A distractor the agent never encodes tests nothing. (b) An ALL-FLOOR battery (no leg moves in any arm) self-routes substrate_not_ready. (c) Rule state must be non-degenerate: if the rule-creator emits monomodal rule state, leg (c)'s 'rule verified intact' conditioning is vacuous -- check against the ARC-062 GAP-B monostrategy-collapse status before running.

items.objective: Establish whether behavioural-competence updates need the bounded / provenanced / rollback-capable discipline that the memory-consolidation path already has (MECH-392 provenance+contradiction-flag+rollback, INV-080 raw-episode preservation, MECH-401 gated-write authority). The asymmetry is the point: consolidation has the discipline, policy/affordance/action-object learning has NO rollback, NO provenance record, and NO gate against a single successful rollout propagating widely. The question this answers is the intake's own: does a LOCAL competence update degrade UNRELATED competences?
items.design: Local-update interference test. Phase 1: train the agent to above-floor performance on a SET of separable competences, verifying each independently. Phase 2: apply a TARGETED competence improvement to exactly one of them, across a perturbation-strength range (the strength sweep is what turns a single point into a dose-response). Phase 3: re-measure performance on the UNRELATED previously-acquired competences. PRIMARY DV: change in unrelated-competence performance as a function of targeted-update strength. Author via /queue-experiment; emit the phase-1-trained pre-update arm fingerprint with include_driver_script_in_hash=False -- it is a reusable baseline for the whole cluster-E line.
acceptance_checks: FAIL-DIRECTION-IS-THE-MOTIVATING-RESULT / the discipline IS needed: unrelated competence degrades measurably as targeted-update strength rises, beyond a margin scaled on the SD of the DELTA plus an absolute floor. NOTE THE POLARITY -- this outcome SUPPORTS MECH-471 and motivates building bounded/provenanced/rollback machinery for the competence path.

PASS-AS-NOT-NEEDED / MECH-471 weakened: unrelated competence is preserved across the full perturbation range, so competence learning is already sufficiently local and the consolidation-path discipline does not need generalising. Decision-relevant negative that would park the whole bounded-competence-revision line.

NON-DEGENERACY (else substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT a verdict): THE 'UNRELATED' COMPETENCES MUST BE DEMONSTRABLY ACQUIRED IN THE BASELINE -- above-floor performance WITH live cross-seed variance, verified in phase 1 before phase 2 runs. Testing interference against competences the agent never had is vacuous and is the single most likely way this experiment returns a meaningless PASS. Also required: the targeted update must actually MOVE the targeted competence, or nothing was perturbed.

items.objective: Test whether held-out context distinguishes genuine skill acquisition from task memorisation, so that competence updates can be promoted to durable only on evidence from contexts that did not generate them. Supplies the promotion gate that MECH-471's bounded-update discipline would need in order to decide WHEN an update has earned durability.
items.design: Paired in-context vs held-out-context evaluation of the SAME learned competence. Train a competence in a generating context set; evaluate on (a) the generating contexts and (b) a held-out context set matched on task structure but differing in surface configuration. PRIMARY DV: the in-context minus held-out performance GAP. Sweep training exposure so the gap can be traced as a function of overtraining -- a memorisation reading predicts the gap WIDENS with exposure while in-context performance saturates. Author via /queue-experiment; reuse the EXP-0399 phase-1-trained baseline arm fingerprint if the competence set matches.
acceptance_checks: PASS / held-out context is a usable acquisition-vs-memorisation discriminator: the gap is near zero for competences trained to generalise and grows measurably under overtraining, beyond a margin scaled on the SD of the DELTA plus an absolute floor.

FAIL / the gap does not discriminate: in-context and held-out performance move together across the whole exposure sweep, so the gap carries no information about memorisation and cannot serve as a promotion gate. Decision-relevant -- MECH-472 would not be usable as the durability criterion for MECH-471.

NON-DEGENERACY (else substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT a verdict): THE HELD-OUT CONTEXTS MUST BE GENUINELY REACHABLE BY THE TRAINED POLICY -- non-zero baseline completion in the held-out set. If they are not, the measured gap is a FLOOR ARTEFACT, not evidence of memorisation. This is the guard most likely to be skipped and the most likely source of a false positive. Also required: in-context performance must be above floor, or there is no acquisition to test for.

items.objective: Test the NARROW form of learning-mechanism meta-selection: does the control plane benefit from selecting among the learning regimes REE actually has -- online practice, exploration, counterfactual simulation, offline consolidation -- rather than applying one rule universally, with the selection state- and mode-dependent? Partial precedent exists but does not cover this: MECH-312b/c arbitrate habit vs goal-directed CONTROL, MECH-261 gates WHICH SUBSTRATE MAY WRITE by mode, MECH-179 routes error TYPE to sleep PHASE. Arbitration over the LEARNING MECHANISM ITSELF is unregistered and untested.
items.design: Fixed-regime arms (one per regime: online practice / exploration / counterfactual simulation / offline consolidation) versus a SELECTING arm, on a task mix deliberately constructed so different sub-tasks reward different regimes. STEP 0, MANDATORY AND RUN FIRST: the fixed-arm baseline must establish that AT LEAST TWO regimes win on DIFFERENT sub-tasks. If one regime dominates everywhere, there is nothing to select between and the experiment is vacuous -- stop there and report substrate_not_ready rather than running the selecting arm. PRIMARY DV: per-sub-task and aggregate performance, selector vs EACH fixed regime. *** SCOPE: NARROW FORM ONLY *** -- the regime menu is exactly the four REE has. Do NOT add imitation or language-mediated scaffolding; both are substrate-blocked (unbuilt) and the broad form is deliberately not registered as testable. Author via /queue-experiment; emit each fixed-regime arm fingerprint with include_driver_script_in_hash=False.
acceptance_checks: PASS / MECH-474 supported: the selecting arm beats EVERY fixed regime, not merely their mean, by a margin scaled on the SD of the DELTA plus an absolute floor. The every-regime bar is the load-bearing one -- beating the MEAN is satisfied by a selector that always picks the single best fixed regime, which demonstrates no selection at all.

FAIL / one universal rule suffices: the selecting arm fails to beat the best fixed regime, so regime meta-selection buys nothing on a mix that demonstrably dissociates the regimes. Decision-relevant negative.

NON-DEGENERACY (else substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT a verdict): THE TASK MIX MUST ACTUALLY DISSOCIATE THE REGIMES -- at least two regimes winning on different sub-tasks in the FIXED-ARM baseline, verified at step 0 before the selecting arm runs. Additionally the selector must be observed to actually SWITCH regime (non-degenerate selection distribution); a selector pinned to one regime is a fixed arm wearing a different label.

items.objective: Test whether SD-032b's dACC-analog output conflates two separable channels -- strategy authority (does accumulated action-outcome evidence retain control) and execution gain (how strongly the persisting policy is expressed) -- as MECH-480 proposes from an ACC/LOFC causal-dissociation paper. Deliberately uses a logit-margin/confidence execution-strength DV rather than action-class entropy, so the test does NOT require committed-action diversity and is not blocked by the F-dominance/committed-action floor-lock that has stalled MECH-260's own c2 retest (see MECH-260 notes, GOV-CEIL-1).
items.design: Two-arm ablation on an existing REE task with a reward-contingency change mid-episode (reuse an existing SD-032b/MECH-445-series env if one already has a contingency-switch phase; otherwise the smallest addition to the current fishtank_viz-style env that adds one). Arm A (dacc_weight=0, SD-032b OFF): baseline. Arm B (dacc_weight>0, SD-032b ON, as currently configured): dACC-analog active. PRIMARY DVs per arm, per seed: (i) outcome-sensitivity -- does the agent's trajectory selection shift toward the newly-favoured option within N ticks of the contingency change (an authority metric); (ii) execution strength -- softmax logit margin / selection confidence of the committed action at steady state (a gain metric, NOT action-class entropy). STEP 0, MANDATORY: confirm execution strength (logit margin) shows non-zero cross-arm and cross-seed variance in Arm A before treating any cross-arm comparison as a verdict -- if it is pinned near ceiling/floor in both arms, self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue.
acceptance_checks: PASS / MECH-480 supported (dissociation): outcome-sensitivity is significantly worse in Arm A than Arm B, while execution strength (logit margin) does NOT differ significantly between arms -- the two vary independently, supporting a distinct execution-gain channel not currently captured by SD-032b's single adjustment-magnitude output.

FAIL / MECH-480 not supported (no dissociation): outcome-sensitivity and execution strength move together (both degrade in Arm A, or neither differs) at matched effect size -- fold this claim back into SD-032b; no separate execution-gain channel is warranted by this test.

NON-DEGENERACY (else substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT a verdict): execution-strength (logit margin) must show non-zero cross-arm/cross-seed variance in Arm A; a metric pinned at ceiling or floor regardless of arm cannot discriminate the two readings above.

items.gating_reason: DECLINED at the /queue-experiment substrate-readiness guardrail (2026-08-27). The design's own pre-registered non-degeneracy gate is EMPIRICALLY UNREACHABLE on the current commit gate, measured 3/3 seeds in the boundary regime this proposal exists to create. (1) The REACHABILITY sentence in MECH-465's what_would_answer -- 'settled on recorded data, no longer open', citing rv p5 0.00259 / p25 0.00330 / median 0.00562 / p75 0.00618 / p95 0.00720 -- reproduces EXACTLY as the POOLED-ACROSS-SEEDS distribution of V3-EXQ-785a's per-tick rv. Post-warmup WITHIN-seed IQR/median is 0.0104-0.0848, not 0.51: the pre-registered P2 floor IS the pooled figure, and pooled dispersion here is almost entirely BETWEEN-seed. Urgency sweeps the threshold +29% across the grid, larger than the whole within-seed rv spread, so per seed the gate is a STEP function of urgency and the residual DV's own empirical-CDF counterfactual predicts exactly that step. Scored pooled, P1/P2 pass while measuring seed identity; scored per-seed they fail. This is the same class of arithmetic-determination defect the 2026-08-26 digestion pass caught one level up -- P3 strips the threshold sliding against a fixed distribution, but not the distribution being five point masses. (2) A 4000-point geometric threshold sweep over the recorded post-warmup rv finds ZERO thresholds satisfying P1 ('commit rate at EVERY urgency level in [0.05,0.95]') on ANY of the 5 seeds (best 5/6, seed 3); only the POOLED distribution appears feasible, which is the artefact. Per-seed centred calibration and grid-narrowing were both tested on recorded data and both fail as general designs. (3) LIVE PROBE, replicating the 785a harness exactly (alpha_world 0.9, gain 0.5, 600 ticks, post-warmup tick>=90) at ree-v3 post-2023589: P2 fails 3/3 by 11-19x (IQR/median 0.0266 / 0.0450 / 0.0279 vs the 0.51 floor) and P1 fails 3/3 (seed 3 floor-pinned at 0.0 on all six levels; seed 0 ceiling-pinned at 1.0 on four; seed 1 breaches the 0.95 ceiling on three). The boundary regime shifts the rv LOCATION substantially, as the proposal predicted, but leaves DISPERSION a point mass -- and dispersion is what P2 and P3 need. (4) A third failure the recorded data could not show: the calibration target moves further than the band is wide. Seed 3, calibrated at 0.00283 against a recorded median of 0.003366, realised a median of 0.008918 under that threshold (3.15x the threshold, commitment never fires); seed 0 moved -35%. The induced perturbation (35-165%) is 7-50x the graded band's width (2.7-4.5%), so the proposal's '3-threshold x 1-seed x 500-tick sweep' has no demonstrated stable operating point. ROOT CAUSE: the gate reads commit_variance = E3._running_variance, an EMA at precision_ema_alpha=0.05 (~20-tick time constant) over world-model prediction error, which in a stationary env converges to a per-seed near-point-mass -- structurally the wrong quantity to place a threshold inside. Both substrate alternatives that WOULD carry within-run dispersion are select()-level kwargs with ZERO occurrences in agent.py, so the live agent path always gates on the EMA. DO NOT resolve by lowering the P2 floor (/queue-experiment Step 3: a pre-registered value that provably fails a gate is a design-time proof, not a substrate fact). PRIOR ART, read after the initial block and CORROBORATING it by an independent route: the 2026-07-20 stage-1 and 2026-07-21 stage-2 MECH-465 spikes (evidence/planning/mech465_commit_gate_boundary_spike_2026-07-20.md, mech465_stage2_conditional_gate_probe_2026-07-21.md) had ALREADY established that the boundary regime is not reachable -- rv at 1.02-1.07x, and SD-063's trained conditional gate at 1.2473x in the deployment condition -- and located the binding constraint UPSTREAM at the untrained z_world encoder. The 2026-08-26 digestion pass that minted this proposal asserted 'REACHABILITY (settled on recorded data, no longer open)' without reconciling those two artifacts, which say the opposite; that is the substance of governance flag GFLAG-0056. Full analysis, tables and reproduction: evidence/planning/mech465_boundary_regime_reachability_probe_20260827.md.

items.design: One sequence, one PRE-REGISTERED outcome span (S >= 2.0), OPERATOR-LEVEL driver (not an agent run), tracing FORM -> CRYSTALLISE -> DISSOLVE -> REVIVE. The existing V3-EXQ-829/829a driver is REUSABLE -- it already crosses retention x f_reacq{1.0,0.5,0.25,0.1} x W{30,100} plus a mild-dissolution control -- and needs ONE addition: an ACQUISITION-SIDE ARM so r_acq is MEASURED on the same run rather than assumed. acceptance_checks: NON-DEGENERACY 1: chunks actually form, checked from PER-SEED rows against a pre-registered worst-seed floor BEFORE any downstream statistic is trusted. Use V3-EXQ-810a's calibrated bar (cleared 7/8 seeds vs a 0.75 fraction; worst-seed margins 2.4x-7.0x); do not invent a new one. V3-EXQ-834 is the counter-example making this per-seed: it returned precondition_unmet on chunks_formed while 4/5 seeds HAD formed 8-44 chunks each -- a driver gate-strictness defect, not a substrate ceiling.

NON-DEGENERACY 2: outcome span PRE-REGISTERED and >= 2.0. F_low/F_high are SCALE-RELATIVE (policy_chunking._variance is plain population variance over the raw unbounded E3-score-receipt scalar; no normalisation anywhere). Population variance on a span-S range is at most S^2/4, so at F_high=0.45 dissolution needs S > 1.342. AT THE REGISTERED DEFAULTS ON A 0-1 SCALE THE CRYSTALLISED->DISSOLVING TRANSITION IS ARITHMETICALLY IMPOSSIBLE, taking DISSOLVED and all three relapse falsifiers out of reach. Emit the reachability arithmetic as an explicit per-cell precondition.

NON-DEGENERACY 3: use_reacquisition_window_isolation ON, and report r_reacq/W per cell as a standing degeneracy check. r_reacq/W ~ 0.9 with low variance means the INSTRUMENT produced the number, not the claim.

NON-DEGENERACY 4: retention state DECLARED per arm (with retention ON the bar is ceil(R_min * f_reacq) for any sequence carrying a dormant chunk, so R_min and R_reacq cells are otherwise silently pooled); and persistence flags scoped to the PROBE phase only, formation at lineage defaults (the V3-EXQ-871 guard: cell-wide flags perturb formation via RNG-coupled env dynamics, same seeds 101/505 forming 1/0 chunks vs 2/2 under 841).

TARGET THE RELATIONS, NEVER THE CONSTANTS. R_min=20, W=100, F_low=0.15, F_high=0.45, f_reacq=0.25, chunk size 2-5 are UNCALIBRATED ENGINEERING DEFAULTS with no literature support; only the orderings are grounded (Barnes 2005; Bouton 2012; Ramkumar 2016; Bo/Seidler 2009). A result turning on a specific value scores nothing.

PASS (MECH-323 C2 / MECH-324 F1): re-formation of a dormant chunk under an identical consistent above-baseline regime completes in STRICTLY FEWER repetitions than first acquisition of the SAME sequence, with r_acq measured on the same run -- r_reacq < r_acq -- AND r_reacq monotonic-decreasing in f_reacq across >=3 levels (a rank ordering, not a value match).

FAIL: r_reacq >= r_acq with the isolation flag ON and the formation precondition met -- falsifies the state-dependence itself, not merely f_reacq's value. DISTINGUISH FROM: r_reacq FLAT across f_reacq with r_reacq/W no longer tracking W, which is the genuine structural falsification that V3-EXQ-829's result was mistaken for.

PASS (MECH-324 C2/C3/C4): retention-not-erasure holds (829's C3 already clean: dormant-flag OFF -> 12/12 dissolved cells stayed dead, ON -> revived); hysteresis measured as CROSSINGS not read off config (F_high > F_low as measured crossing points AND dissolution taking strictly more trials than formation on the same sequence in the same run); recoverability from DISSOLVING holds.

OUT OF SCOPE, do not smuggle in: MECH-324's renewal (F4) and resurgence (F5) legs. F4 is blocked UPSTREAM on MECH-323's never-populated initiation_set (ChunkedPrimitive.initiation_set defaults to frozenset(), neither mint call site populates it, verified unchanged 2026-08-28) and ultimately on a bucket-count measurement rooted in SD-008 z_world under-differentiation. CEILING-HEADROOM CHECK (precondition on the FALSIFYING branch specifically): fraction-of-ceiling in the ALL-OFF arm must be materially below 1.0. A null in the OFF arm is uninformative -- there is nothing to lift.

MANDATORY INSTRUMENTS, whose absence made the prior lineage unreadable: (i) mean_distinct_first_action_classes per arm as a covariate, with the DV reported as a FRACTION of ln(distinct) rather than an absolute nat count; (ii) yoked per-tick committed-action divergence against a matched control sharing a PRIVATE RNG stream (the V3-EXQ-949 design), which detects authority acquisition even when episode-level entropy has not moved; (iii) authority_rel_deviation_mean per arm.

PASS: with P1 armed, ARM_NOISE produces committed (argmax) selected_action_entropy -- as fraction-of-ceiling -- STRICTLY ABOVE the matched-pre-commit-variance ARM_TEMP control on >=2/3 seeds, with the diversity reaching the COMMITTED action.

SECONDARY (both asserted by MECH-440 and NEITHER ever measured): STATE-CONDITIONING -- per-state noise magnitude covaries with state rather than being uniform; SELF-ANNEALING -- per-parameter sigma (or the local confidence EMA standing in for it) FALLS where the policy is confident. A run confirming only the entropy lift establishes propagation and leaves two thirds of the claim untested.

FAIL: (a) washes out at the argmax identically to the temperature floor (valid ONLY once the ceiling-headroom check passes); or (b) raises pre-commit entropy without raising committed-action diversity -- thrash, not carve; or (c) raises committed diversity but the noise is measurably state-INDEPENDENT and non-annealing, supporting a plain stochastic floor (MECH-313's original framing) and refuting MECH-440's refinement while leaving the injection-site correction standing.

HONEST LIMIT, do not over-read: V3-EXQ-949's DV is per-tick committed-ACTION divergence in a yoked pair, not committed-CLASS entropy over an episode. It proves the channel acquires argmin authority; it does NOT prove that authority converts into sustained class diversity. That conversion is what THIS run must measure.
SCOPE: this does NOT refute MECH-439 F-dominance or ARC-110's intrinsic-ceiling finding; both may still hold at a raised floor. A null here at a raised floor is a genuine result for the first time.
